name: Fathom
description: Fathom is an AI meeting assistant with a developer API, SDKs and an official MCP server.
auth_notes: SDKs authenticate with API keys; OAuth is mentioned for public apps other Fathom users install.
gate_detail: Sources do not state how to obtain an API key or any plan requirement for the Fathom meeting product. The Fathom Analytics source is a different product and was ignored.
api_scope: Developer docs list API docs, API reference and TypeScript and Python SDKs for meeting data; endpoints are not detailed in the sources.
mcp_notes: Fathom says it offers an official MCP server for connecting meeting data to Claude and ChatGPT; URL not stated.
blocker_detail: Key issuance, plan requirements and approval steps are not established by the sources.
